name: @latticekit/example-wayfinding
description: WAYFINDING — a gallery exhibit. A flow field re-routing a moving crowd the instant the map changes.
$comment: Six of nine. The exhibit is `iso.path`'s FlowField and nothing else: one field, four hundred and twenty readers, and a map that changes under all of them in the same frame. `sim`, `persist` and `audio` have nothing to do here.
